tier1.text: Each cerebral hemisphere controls the opposite side of the body. A deep groove divides the cerebrum, the largest part of the brain, into two cerebral hemispheres. The left hemisphere is more devoted to language, and the right to spatial and nonverbal reasoning. However, neither hemisphere has these functions all to itself.

sentences.text: Each cerebral hemisphere controls the opposite side of the body.

quotes.quote: Ascending neural pathways cross in this section of the brain allowing the left hemisphere of the cerebrum to control the right side of the body and vice versa.
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: A deep groove divides the cerebrum, the largest part of the brain, into two cerebral hemispheres.

quotes.quote: The largest and most obvious portion of the brain is the cerebrum, which is divided by a deep longitudinal fissure into two cerebral hemispheres.
quotes.section: SEER Training Modules: The Central Nervous System
quotes.citation: SEER Training Modules: The Central Nervous System. U.S. National Institutes of Health, National Cancer Institute.

sentences.text: The left hemisphere is more devoted to language, and the right to spatial and nonverbal reasoning.

quotes.quote: There is some lateralization of function, in which the left side of the brain is devoted to language function and the right side is devoted to spatial and nonverbal reasoning.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.

sentences.text: However, neither hemisphere has these functions all to itself.

quotes.quote: Whereas these functions are predominantly associated with those sides of the brain, there is no monopoly by either side on these functions.
quotes.citation: Betts JG, Young KA, Wise JA, Johnson E, Poe B, Kruse DH, Korol O, Johnson JE, Womble M, DeSaix P (2022). Anatomy and Physiology 2e. OpenStax.
